data.name: Ulisses
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Ulisses is the name of a legendary hero who is renowned for his wisdom and cleverness. The name is derived from the Greek word 'ulisso', which means 'ulcer' or 'wound', reflecting the hero's ability to heal and overcome adversity. Ulisses is also known as Ulysses in Latin and Odysseus in Greek mythology, and his adventures and journeys are chronicled in Homer's epic poem, The Odyssey.
